name: section_cuts_the_part
why: ENTRY GT4. A part with an internal cavity, without a section, cannot be read in the workshop: the hidden lines say that there is a void, not what shape it has. It is the first thing that is missing for a real mechanical drawing.
_why_the_part_has_a_pocket: A solid plate would be sectioned all the same, and the case would be green without proving anything: the hatching would be there anyway. With a pocket inside, the section has something to SHOW, and it is the reason the operation exists.
defect_caught: A section view that is born without having cut anything. `CreateSectionViewAt5` does not take the cut in its signature — it takes it from the selection — and a line that fell outside the material produces a FORMALLY VALID and empty view: it is counted, looks good, and shows nothing. That is why the case is not satisfied with «the view is there»: it demands the HATCHING, which is the only thing that tells a cut inside the material from one in the void.

expect.why: if the part is not the right one, neither is the drawing
192000 minus the pocket 60x30x10 = 18000. It is the cavity the section must show
a drawing is made on a saved part: if the save warns, the view might point to a file that is not there
from here on the active document is another one
without a model view there is nothing to section

expect._and_this_is_the_line_that_counts: **THE HATCHING IS THE ONLY THING THAT TELLS A SECTION FROM AN EMPTY VIEW.** `views_after` goes up even when the cutting line falls outside the material: that view is counted, looks good, and shows nothing. A hatching means that the cut met some solid.
expect.why: one: the vertical cut in the middle goes through the plate, which there is a single body
the type of the view born, not the fact that the count went up: one more projection view would make the count go up all the same
three model views plus the SHEET, which in the SOLIDWORKS list is the first «view». The number is here so that whoever reads the case does not have to discover it
one more, and it is the true check: `CreateSectionViewAt5` can answer an object without having done anything
the default value, stated in the answer instead of implied
the blindness that counts: the hatching says that the cut met material, not that it goes through the cavity one wanted to show
